title: LOG_METABOLISM_COHORT_ROW_V1
description: One JSONL object per line: domain-neutral scalars for log/metric cohort spikes. Narrative labels (e.g. fire/metal) belong in report metadata only.

window_start_utc.description: RFC3339 / ISO8601 window start for the aggregate row.

trace_scope.description: Optional correlation key (service, shard, tenant id) — non-PII token.

egress_pressure.description: Expansion proxy: e.g. requests_per_minute, error_rate, or normalized egress index.

throttle_events.description: Convergence proxy: e.g. 429 count, circuit_breaker opens, throttle interventions per window.

persistence_density.description: Optional: stable key cardinality / durable state density in [0,1].

phase_transition_threshold.description: Optional: precomputed threshold hit indicator or configured cutoff (engine-neutral).
